title: Selfish Reasons To Have More Kids

questions.q: What do twin studies suggest about long-term parenting choices?
a: Genes shape outcomes more than the parenting style does
Adoptive parents shape outcomes the most
School choice matters more than either
Birth order is the strongest predictor
questions.why: Lesson 1 cites twin studies showing genetic parents matter more than upbringing.

questions.q: What does the summary advise parents to do after conceiving?
a: Pick a co-parent whose traits you like and relax about the rest
Read every popular parenting book available
Fill the calendar with extracurricular activities
Delay school until the child seems ready
questions.why: Lesson 1 says to choose a good co-parent and not sweat the small stuff.

questions.q: What does the summary claim about children today?
a: They have never had it better in human history
They face more hazards than any earlier generation
Their health has declined because of processed food
Kidnappings are far more common than in the past
questions.why: Lesson 2 says children's health, safety and quality of life have never been better.

questions.q: What does the summary say about stranger danger?
a: Rare events get attention, so the risk feels larger
It is the leading danger facing young children
It has grown sharply because of social media
It mostly affects children in rural areas
questions.why: Lesson 2 calls stranger danger overblown because rare events get heavy coverage.

questions.q: Why does the summary suggest having more children than planned?
a: A lighter parenting style costs far less time and money
Governments offer generous payments for each child
Siblings make each child easier to raise
Larger families get cheaper housing
questions.why: Lesson 3 says intensive parenting is optional and inflates the perceived cost.
